fusions.name: Ink Spray
fusions.desc: Sprays a wide cone that deals 7 damage to everything in it, leaves it [Stunned] for 0.8 seconds, and has a 60% chance of [Blunted] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Slow Squeeze
fusions.desc: Fires a round that deals 30 damage and is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Arms Wide
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 5 enemies within 8 tiles onto you for 8 seconds. A second pair of arms fights beside you for 12 seconds, striking for 4 every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Many Hands
fusions.desc: When you spend stamina, you regain 2 stamina a second for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
